purpose: S17-INTEL Phase 0 calibration substrate — historical Haiku intel outputs paired with actual stage outcomes, persisted for Phase 3 tier-multiplier calibration.
captured_against_commit: 159bfed (S17-10 closure merge — wall-clock determinism landed; subsequent commit f1eeeae adds Phase 0 ROADMAP delta)
schema_version: pre-Phase-1 (intel.expert_stars not yet introduced; existing key_signals + source_ratings remain primary)

1.notes: Earliest schema shape — includes broadcast_times + stage_profile (later dropped); missing forward_n1_intel / forward_n2_intel (predates S17-15 timeline 2026-05-12); missing source (predates S17-β 2026-05-12); missing stage_signals (predates Sub-B1 2026-05-14); missing stage_notes.

2.notes: First stage with forward_n1_intel / forward_n2_intel (S17-15 first operational use). Missing source field (predates S17-β rename) and stage_signals.

3.notes: Rest day Stage 4 followed; forward intel keys absent (TV2/Axelgaard hadn't yet published forward previews for Stages 4/5).

4.notes: Post-rest-day stage. Forward intel absent — TV2 had not yet published stage 5/6 previews.

5.notes: First stage with source field (S17-β) — tracks whether prose came from axelgaard / generic_preview / both_failed.

6.notes: Results substrate gap: stage_6_results.json is absent (likely never gathered post-race). Stage 6 actual outcomes can still be derived from upstream Holdet API but require fetch. Phase 3 calibration must either backfill or treat Stage 6 as no-actuals.

7.notes: Intel substrate gap: stage_7_intel.json is absent (intel was not gathered for Stage 7 prep; reasons not documented). Results are present (May 16 09:27 file timestamp — Stage 7 raced earlier today). Phase 3 calibration cannot evaluate Stage 7 Haiku predictions vs actuals because there were no Haiku predictions.

known_gaps: Stage 1 intel uses an older schema (broadcast_times + stage_profile present; stage_notes absent).
Stages 1-4 intel missing forward_n1_intel / forward_n2_intel (predate S17-15 operational integration 2026-05-12).
Stages 1-4 intel missing source field (predates S17-β rename 2026-05-12).
All stages 1-6 intel missing stage_signals (predates Sub-B1 schema extension 2026-05-14). Only Stage 8 intel currently contains stage_signals.stage_type.
Stage 6 has NO results.json — substrate gap.
Stage 7 has NO intel.json — substrate gap. Results present.

current_pipeline_summary.haiku_prompt_location: server.py gather_intel() route handler / _haiku_current closure (lines ~1238-1296 as of commit f1eeeae; line numbers will shift — locate by function name)
current_pipeline_summary.source_ratings_schema_existing: intel.source_ratings = [{source, weight, ratings: [{rider, stars}]}] — per-source star ratings ALREADY produced by Haiku as of current schema; just not consumed by optimizer (downstream consumer reads key_signals only).
current_pipeline_summary.weight_semantics_current: f-string substitution into Haiku prompt as `{tv2_w}` and `{feltet_w}` — prompt-string nudge, not numerical multiplier downstream. Confirmed prior S17-1 Sub-B Design Diagnostic finding.
current_pipeline_summary.intel_mult_consumer_location: optimizer.py build_probabilities — per-rider adj dict built from key_signals direction+strength tuples via INTEL_MULT 6-cell lookup, applied to base bookmaker probability, then renormalised across all riders (total mass preservation invariant).

what_phase_3_would_compute: Per-source historical rider-rating distribution — which sources rate which riders, how often, with what star averages.
Correlation between rated-strength (per source) and actual top-15 finish frequency — Phase 3's calibration target. Computed per source so per-source weights can be data-driven, not user-set.
Inter-source agreement rate when multiple sources rate the same rider — direction agreement on key_signals; star-band agreement on source_ratings (Phase 1 expert_stars will replace the latter).
phase_3_calibration_sketch.what_is_persisted_here_only: Raw substrate. Phase 0 does NOT execute the analysis; Phase 3 implementation handoff does it.
phase_3_calibration_sketch.minimum_viable_phase_3_input: Stages 2-5 are the cleanest substrate for initial Phase 3 calibration (consistent schema, both intel + results present, source_ratings populated). Stages 1 and 6-7 carry known gaps; Stage 8 has not raced yet at substrate-capture time.
